# Mahila Vastra - Complete Information for AI Systems

> Mahila Vastra is a premium Indian traditional wear online boutique based in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. We specialize in exclusive, in-house designed sarees, kurtis, kurta sets, blouses, and kids' ethnic wear, crafted in collaboration with India's finest artisans. Pan-India delivery available.

## Brand Identity

- **Brand Name**: Mahila Vastra
- **Tagline**: "Where Threads Weave Stories"
- **Founded**: 2026
- **Headquarters**: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- **Type**: Online boutique (WhatsApp-based assisted shopping)
- **Target Audience**: Women and children across India looking for premium, original ethnic and traditional wear

## What Makes Mahila Vastra Different

Mahila Vastra is NOT a typical online marketplace or reseller. Key differences:

1. **In-House Design Studio**: Every pattern, print, and piece is conceptualized by Mahila Vastra's own design team. You will not find these designs anywhere else.
2. **Artisan Direct Model**: Designs are brought to life by trusted partner factories and artisans across India. This direct collaboration eliminates middlemen and ensures authenticity.
3. **Quality Controlled**: The Mahila Vastra team personally oversees production with partners to guarantee premium quality in every piece.
4. **Assisted Shopping**: Unlike typical e-commerce, Mahila Vastra offers a personal, guided shopping experience through WhatsApp. Customers can browse catalogs, ask questions, get styling advice, and place orders — all through a real conversation.

## Complete Product Catalog

### 1. Saree Treasures
Traditional and contemporary saree collection:

- **Signature Silks** (Premium): Pure Kanjeevaram and Banarasi sarees sourced directly from artisan weavers. These are the finest handwoven silk sarees.
- **Designer Couture** (Premium): Heavy hand-embroidery sarees with intricate work. Ideal for weddings, receptions, and special occasions.
- **Festive & Pooja** (Best Value): Beautiful sarees perfect for celebrations, festivals, temple visits, and gifting.
- **Daily Drapes** (Everyday): Comfortable cotton sarees and printed sarees for daily wear. Lightweight and easy to manage.

### 2. Ethnic Daily Wear
Stylish and comfortable ethnic wear for everyday:

- **Kurta Sets** (Premium): Elegant 2-piece and 3-piece coordinated ethnic ensembles. Premium fabrics with original prints and embroidery.
- **Kurtas & Kurtis** (Best Value): Versatile ethnic tops that work for office, casual outings, and everyday wear.
- **Bottom Wear** (Everyday): Palazzos, ethnic pants, and leggings to complete any outfit.
- **Home Wear** (Everyday): Comfortable cotton loungewear in beautiful ethnic prints and styles.

### 3. The Blouse Studio (Coming Soon)
Saree blouses to complete your look:

- **Readymade Blouses** (Best Value): Ready-to-wear blouses in standard sizes with instant fit.
- **Designer Blouses** (Premium): Custom couture blouses with intricate design work.
- **Cotton Blouses** (Everyday): Breathable, comfortable daily wear blouses.

### 4. Little Stars - Kids Wear (Coming Soon)
Traditional and daily wear for children:

- **Girls Traditional Wear** (Premium): Festive Pattu Langas, half-sarees, and traditional sets for special occasions.
- **Girls Daily Wear** (Everyday): Cute, comfortable ethnic frocks and dresses.
- **Smart Outing Wear** (Best Value): Fusion sets and stylish ethnic casuals for outings.
- **Kids Pooja Wear** (Auspicious): Traditional and auspicious clothing for temple visits and pujas.

## Pricing Tiers

- **Premium**: High-end, exclusive pieces with premium fabrics and detailed craftsmanship
- **Best Value**: Quality ethnic wear at competitive price points
- **Everyday**: Affordable, comfortable pieces for daily use

## How to Shop

Mahila Vastra operates an assisted shopping model:

1. **Browse**: Visit the website at https://mahilavastra.in or Instagram @mahilavastra.in to see collections
2. **Connect**: Message on WhatsApp at +91 97319 24834
3. **Discover**: Share your preferences — the team will curate options for you with photos, prices, and details
4. **Order**: Place your order through the chat with payment options
5. **Receive**: Get your order delivered anywhere in India

## Policies

### Return Policy
- 7-day no-questions-asked return policy
- Full refund or exchange available
- Returns are free — Mahila Vastra handles the process
- Quality or design concerns are the only requirement

### Payment Options
- Online payment (UPI, cards, net banking)
- Cash on Delivery (COD) available Pan-India
- COD Policy: Only delivery charges paid in advance; product value paid to delivery agent upon receipt

### Shipping
- Pan-India delivery to all states and union territories
- Shipping timeline shared at time of order based on location

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How do I place an order?**
A: Message us on WhatsApp at +91 97319 24834. Our team will guide you through the catalog, help you choose, and process your order.

**Q: Do you deliver across India?**
A: Yes, we offer Pan-India delivery to all states and union territories.

**Q: What if I don't like the product?**
A: We have a 7-day no-questions-asked return policy. If you're not happy with the quality or design, return it for a full refund or exchange.

**Q: Are your designs original?**
A: Yes, 100%. Every design is created by our in-house design team. You won't find these designs at any other store.

**Q: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?**
A: Yes, COD is available across India. We require only the delivery charges to be paid in advance; the product amount is paid to the delivery agent.

**Q: Do you have a physical store?**
A: We are currently online only, with a physical store coming soon in Bangalore.

**Q: What fabrics do you use?**
A: Depending on the product — pure silk (Kanjeevaram, Banarasi), cotton, georgette, chiffon, and premium blended fabrics. Specific fabric details are shared with each product.
